items.stem: A taxpayer's marginal rate is 40% but they pay 28% of total income in tax. The 28% figure is the:

options.rationale: Correct: tax paid divided by total income is the effective rate.
The marginal rate applies only to the top slice of income.
The headline rate is a published band rate, not the average paid.
Withholding is a collection mechanism, not this average measure.

items.explanation: Correct: tax paid divided by total income is the effective rate.

items.stem: Which two statements about VAT/GST are conceptually correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Registered businesses generally collect it on behalf of the government
options.rationale: Correct: VAT is collected by businesses and remitted onward.

options.text: The final consumer typically bears the economic cost
options.rationale: Correct: VAT is designed to fall on final consumption.

options.text: It is a direct tax on company profits
options.rationale: VAT is an indirect transaction tax, not a profits tax.

options.text: Exempt and zero-rated supplies are identical in effect
options.rationale: They differ: zero-rated allows input recovery, exempt generally does not.

items.explanation: Correct: VAT is collected by businesses and remitted onward.

items.stem: Deliberately under-reporting income to reduce tax owed is best classified as:

options.rationale: Correct: concealing income to pay less tax is illegal evasion.
Planning uses lawful means; concealment is not lawful.
Avoidance exploits lawful rules; under-reporting is outright illegal.
Deferral delays legitimate tax; this hides a liability entirely.

items.explanation: Correct: concealing income to pay less tax is illegal evasion.
